ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup did fire (swing low in, momentum turned up), but it's LATE — price is already extended above the cycle low (formed ~24 day(s) ago @ 150.17) and overbought (daily RSI 73, 3-day 81 & weekly 82). ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive (investor cycle week 15 · daily cycle day 29).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a high. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.
points: Bigger picture is mixed (no clear trend for a daily long)

entry.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended and overbought (daily RSI 73, 3-day 81 & weekly 82). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
entry.text_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸且超买（日线 RSI 73、3 日 81 与周线 82）。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。
